research_decision: Do not require robustness to inverse-native-dimension noise before pursuing a polynomial clean scalar or native predictor. Stronger source promises can preserve useful clean advantage at an explicit worse gap and precision cost.
clean_primitive: A bounded uniform clean useful-bit predictor with K(t) original copies and advantage epsilon(t), either scalar rank1 or lifted native rank t-8; no primitive is implemented
copy_gate: Reject declared first-bit budgets for which (2^K-1)/(2*q^rank)<epsilon; compare exact integers without constructing the enormous native group size
noise_transfer: For a classical original-Z-mask mixture, even correlated, fixed-secret source-average marginal fault probability<=gamma/2 gives total trace distance<=K*gamma/2. Add actual joint-CQ/uniform-channel preparation and adapter errors. Marginal visibilities alone do not grant this for coherent noise.
budget: gamma=epsilon/(2K), per-call joint preparation error epsilon/(8K), total adapter error epsilon/8 preserve advantage at least epsilon/2
public_source_plan: Use only public B and a squared-norm interval. Bound all parent displacements, solve C/2^m<=gamma(t)/2 with actual t=n*(m+1), choose dyadic packet side to charge its other half, and enforce strict nonparallel/parallel alias thresholds.
proof_obligations: Supply the actual uniform clean predictor, not assumed complexity exponents or correct private-secret fixtures
Prove the original full-label law and correct-trial source promise; no clean/correct-trial oracle
Keep norm/gap and actual source preparation precision unverified unless independently certified
Charge every coordinate/residue/length trial, splitting-prime certificate, parent/packet bit width, source call and finite-gate approximation
Use joint CQ/channel error, not rare-condition normalized state accuracy or arbitrary noise marginals
For correlated faults across repeated calls, budget the entire bounded amplified procedure or prove the fresh independence needed by majority
Dimension-only polynomial gap claims additionally require controlled norm interval and log parent-coefficient bounds; arbitrary public input bit length is not silently dimension-only
falsifiers: The final source modulus changes t so the proposed predictor/noise/box budget no longer closes
A declared native copy budget violates the useful-bit access upper bound
Actual sine-source promise_budget disagrees with the planner or an alias strictness condition fails
A candidate uses private shortest-vector coordinates or silently grants a correct norm/residue trial
A noisy performance transfer invokes local marginals despite a coherent joint-state counterexample
